findings.evidence: The only generator computations are private: `presentationUnit_val` at line 76, `map_tautologicalUnit` at line 163, and the `Polynomial.X` computation inside the private inverse proof at lines 212–221; `rg "coordinateAlgEquiv"` finds no public application lemma in this module.
findings.fix: Expose canonical diagonal/upper-right coordinate accessors and add `[simp]` lemmas for their images under `coordinateAlgEquiv` (and, where useful, its inverse).
findings.issue: `coordinateAlgEquiv` is public but has no lemmas identifying the images of the diagonal Laurent generator and upper-right polynomial generator, so its documented coordinate interpretation is inaccessible without unfolding private definitions.

findings.evidence: In the `SL2Borel` namespace, `rg` finds only `mk` at line 84 and `coe_mk` at line 93, whereas the parallel `GL2Borel` API provides `diag_mk` and `equivProd` in `GeneralLinearGroup/Borel.lean` lines 215 and 318.
findings.fix: Add canonical parameter accessors plus an eta/equivalence theorem, and a `[simp]` theorem describing `map φ (mk a b)`.
findings.issue: The new `SL2Borel.mk` only has `coe_mk`; there is no elimination/eta theorem recovering an arbitrary Borel element from its diagonal unit and upper-right entry, nor a `map_mk` interaction lemma.

summary: The new coordinate presentation and constructor lack the characteristic API needed to use them without unfolding implementation details.
